unresolved_blockers.finding: No operationally verified option-quote source exists. Alpaca contains zero option support (no option/chain/expiry/strike references in alpaca_provider.py), so the only option-chain route is yfinance via GST_Option_Chain_Core. option_chain_adapter.py has no provider-eligibility concept at all -- it never consults is_eligible_for_real_event, which is a bars-provider notion. The option path therefore has no clearance decision of its own.
unresolved_blockers.decision_required_from_human: Choose and operationally validate an option-quote source with per-quote timestamps, or decide the first event proceeds without an option benchmark and accept the resulting completeness tier.

unresolved_blockers.finding: build_option_benchmark() requires the CALLER to supply quote_timestamp_utc and underlying_price. A yfinance option chain carries no per-quote timestamp, so that value would be asserted by the caller rather than observed from the venue. The adapter's own skew and crossed-quote gates (MAX_COMPATIBLE_QUOTE_SKEW_SECONDS=120, REJECTED_BID_GT_ASK, REJECTED_INCOMPATIBLE_TIMESTAMPS) can only be as trustworthy as that asserted input.
unresolved_blockers.decision_required_from_human: Establish an observed, venue-sourced quote timestamp before any real option capture.

Nothing wires Phase 2 panel -> phase2_adapter -> option benchmark -> EventStore.

unresolved_blockers.finding: import_pre_event_fields_for_ticker() takes only (csv_path, marker_path, ticker, research_commit_sha, methodology_version). It hashes both inputs and cross-verifies the marker's counts against the CSV, but it has no expected-session parameter, so it cannot reject a panel from the wrong date. A stale but internally consistent panel would pass every existing check.
